shareLink.versionMismatch: ⚠️ This link was made with an older version of Sol Keeper and can't be replayed here — starting a fresh mission instead.

shareLink.classLinkHint: Every student who opens this link gets the identical mission — same scenario, same seed, same incidents. No accounts, no backend: the whole mission lives in the link itself.

liveSky.title: Live Sky
liveSky.hint: Real data from NASA's own space-weather and navigation feeds — not simulated, and labeled so you always know whether you're looking at this moment or a saved one.
liveSky.distanceLine: {{km}} km from Earth to {{body}} right now
liveSky.radioDelay: A radio message takes {{oneWay}} minutes to arrive one way — {{roundTrip}} minutes for mission control to hear a reply.
liveSky.hintHistorical: No solar activity in the live window right now — here's a real storm from NASA's records instead.
liveSky.hintLive: The same real solar flares and storms that could trigger a radiation-shelter Decision Card.

briefing.specialist: A major dust storm arrives around sol 8, cutting solar power sharply for about two and a half days.
briefing.cadet: ⚠️ Around day 8, a huge dust storm will block the sun for a couple of days.

briefing.specialist: A solar particle event arrives early, around day 4 — the crew will need to shelter.
briefing.cadet: ⚠️ Around day 4, a solar storm means everyone has to hide in the safe room.

briefing.specialist: A solar particle event arrives partway through the first lunar night, around day 6.
briefing.cadet: ⚠️ Around day 6, deep in the first long night, a solar storm hits.

partial.specialist: The mission can end with the whole crew alive but the goal unmet — a real, distinct outcome from a crew loss, not a milder version of it.
partial.cadet: 😕 Everyone can make it home safe, but still not finish the mission's goal.

abort.specialist: The crew can end the mission early, on purpose, if things are going badly enough — a real, deliberate call, not a failure of skill.
abort.cadet: 🛑 You can decide to end the mission early to keep everyone safe.

loss.specialist: If every crew member is lost, the mission ends immediately, whatever else was going right.
loss.cadet: 💔 If the whole crew is lost, the mission is over.

briefing.massLine: {{kg}} kg of hardware, packed with real PDR-phase margin (NASA Ames APR 8070.1) — see the full breakdown on Mission Command.
briefing.massLineCadet: 📦 The ship is packing about {{kg}} kg of gear.
